name: Parameters.cycloConductor_mem_different
summary: N₁(P, s)·d(P) is a multiple of relDifferentGen(P, s)·√−d(P).

steps.claim: By `different_eq_span_relDifferentGen_mul` the different is (relDifferentGen(P, s)·√−d(P)); relDifferentGen(P, s) ∣ N₁(P, s) (`relDifferentGen_dvd_N₁`) and √−d(P) ∣ d(P) (`sqrtNegDInE_dvd`), so relDifferentGen(P, s)·√−d(P) ∣ N₁(P, s)·d(P).
